_comment: Brand kit for Castille Academy — a standalone premium youth athletic-development brand. Keys under `tags` map a layer's field name (its `tag`) to the value that replaces the layer's content at fill time. Source design system lives at kitPath (a Claude Design handoff bundle); see brand/castille-academy/project/README.md for the full brand rules. Campaign/location overlays (data/campaign.*.json, data/location.*.json) override these per launch.
_note: Tokens drawn verbatim from the Castille design system (brand/castille-academy/project/colors_and_type.css): provided palette is black/white/red #a81918, type is Libre Caslon Display (display) / Hanken Grotesk (body) / Saira Condensed (the condensed stat/numeral face → the metrics `font_mono` slot). The bank's AA authoring colors are remapped to these at render/clone time (scripts/lib/palette.mjs). CAVEATS: (1) url is a PLACEHOLDER — no real Castille domain provided yet. (2) logo is the design's TYPOGRAPHIC PLACEHOLDER (rendered from the brand-logo.html lockup), not a commissioned crest. (3) brand_name is all-caps for label/eyebrow contexts; on Caslon DISPLAY contexts the design wants Title Case 'Castille Academy' (no all-caps Caslon). (4) fonts are NOT in the bank preflight set — validateKit warns and static font tokenization is deferred (motion honors the family strings; statics keep the bank face) until the .woff2 binaries are registered in fonts/ + brand/castille-academy/fonts/. (5) guarantee set to the AA program line per user direction (the Castille design itself carries no guarantee — its signature device is the Castille Index).

tags.guarantee: +1 mph speed. +3" vertical. 90 days. Or your training is on us.
